title: Tian Jiuju v. Yang Fan, right to life · Facts (Zhengzhou elevator smoking case)

sources.name: Elevator surveillance video
sources.quote: At 09:24:03 on 2 May 2017 Duan Xiaoli was smoking inside the elevator ... at 09:24:16 the two began talking ... at 09:26:24 they left the elevator

sources.name: Surveillance video at the building entrance

loc.file: Surveillance video at the building entrance

sources.quote: At 09:28:40 the two reached the building entrance; Duan Xiaoli was relatively agitated and Yang Fan relatively calm. At 09:29:06 they headed towards the property management office; until then Duan Xiaoli's cigarette had never gone out

sources.name: Surveillance video at the property management office door

loc.file: Surveillance video at the property management office door

sources.quote: Throughout, Yang Fan remained relatively calm and restrained; the two only talked, with no pulling and no physical altercation ... the three surveillance clips show that Yang Fan and Duan Xiaoli were in contact for under five minutes

sources.name: Diagnosis certificate, Henan Provincial Staff Hospital
sources.quote: 120 was called at 09:31 and paramedics reached the patient at 09:37

sources.name: Police interview records (Yan Changchun; Duan Xiaoli's relatives)
sources.quote: Two minutes later 120 called me and told me to meet them at the compound gate; calls came at 09:40 and 09:42

sources.name: Second-instance judgment in this case

loc.court: Zhengzhou Intermediate People's Court, Henan Province

sources.quote: Yang Fan's dissuading of Duan Xiaoli's smoking did not exceed the necessary limit and was proper ... there is no legal causation between the two, and Yang Fan was not at fault

events.label: Yang Fan enters the elevator and presses B1
events.detail: Yang Fan entered the elevator at 09:24:07 and pressed the button for floor B1

events.label: Duan Xiaoli smokes inside the elevator
events.summary: the lit button was the first floor
events.detail: Duan Xiaoli was smoking inside the elevator; the lit button was the first floor

events.label: The two talk continuously inside the elevator (dissuasion)
events.detail: The two began talking; the conversation continued while the elevator reached the first floor and B1, with some verbal disagreement; at 09:26:24 they left the elevator. The three surveillance clips show they were in contact for under five minutes

events.label: The two reach the building entrance; Duan Xiaoli is agitated
events.detail: Duan Xiaoli was relatively agitated, Yang Fan relatively calm

events.label: The two head for the property management office; Duan Xiaoli's cigarette is still lit
events.detail: The two headed towards the property management office; until then Duan Xiaoli's cigarette had never gone out

events.label: Calling 120
events.detail: The diagnosis certificate from Henan Provincial Staff Hospital records: 120 was called at 09:31 and paramedics reached the patient at 09:37. The judgment does not state who made the call

events.dateNote: Surveillance timestamps run from 09:43:55 to 09:48:56; calibrated against the diagnosis certificate and interview records, the actual time was about 09:33 (the surveillance clock ran some ten minutes fast)
events.label: Argument at the property management office door; Yang Fan is led away
events.detail: The two kept talking at the property management office door; Duan Xiaoli grew increasingly agitated and approached Yang Fan several times, and was pulled back by Zhang Zongyin, the property customer-service manager; Zhang Zongyin led Yang Fan away and Duan Xiaoli was taken to the property office. Property staff Zhang Zongyin and Yan Changchun took part in mediating (not listed among actors)

events.label: Duan Xiaoli dies
events.detail: The judgment anonymises the death and does not state the exact time, so date is accurate only to the day.
